statements.query: SELECT workspace_id,role,(credential_hash <> $1)::boolean AS previous, COALESCE((capabilities->>'credentialFreeVisualCancel')::boolean,false)::boolean AS credential_free_visual_cancel FROM servers WHERE id = $2 AND NOT revoked AND NOT awaiting_transfer AND (credential_hash = $1 OR (previous_hash = $1 AND previous_until>now()))

SELECT t.id,t.unit_id,t.application_id,t.instance,t.controller_generation,t.actor_id FROM troubleshooting_sessions t JOIN servers s ON s.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND s.id = t.server_id WHERE t.workspace_id = $1 AND t.server_id = $2 AND t.state = 'offered' AND t.agent_attached_at IS NULL AND t.ticket_expires_at > now() AND t.controller_generation = s.controller_generation AND s.capabilities->>

SELECT command,cancel_requested,state FROM execution_operations WHERE server_id=$1 AND NOT(kind='crosshost' AND parent_id IS NULL) AND state IN ('dispatched','running','needs_attention') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cross_host_recoveries r WHERE r.parent_id=execution_operations.parent_id AND NOT r.opened AND COALESCE(command->'crosshost'->>'phase','')<>'recovery-open') AND (parent_id IS NULL OR co

UPDATE servers SET last_seen=now(),capabilities = $1,preflight = $2 WHERE workspace_id = $3 AND id = $4 AND NOT revoked AND NOT awaiting_transfer AND (credential_hash = $5 OR (previous_hash = $5 AND previous_until>now())) RETURNING role,rotation_requested,preview_only
UPDATE servers SET poll_id=NULL,poll_until=NULL WHERE id=$1 AND poll_id=$2
UPDATE servers SET poll_id=$2,poll_until=now()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE id=$1 AND (poll_until IS NULL OR poll_until<now())
INSERT INTO server_metrics(workspace_id,server_id,received_at,report) VALUES($1,$2,date_trunc('minute',now()),$3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
DELETE FROM server_metrics WHERE server_id=$1 AND received_at<=now()-interval '24 hours'

SELECT COALESCE(NOT revoked AND NOT awaiting_transfer AND (credential_hash = $1 OR (previous_hash = $1 AND previous_until>now())), false)::boolean AS valid FROM servers WHERE workspace_id = $2 AND id = $3 FOR UPDATE

WITH locked_jobs AS ( SELECT id, args, attempt, attempted_at, attempted_by, created_at, errors, finalized_at, kind, max_attempts, metadata, priority, queue, state, scheduled_at, tags, unique_key, unique_states FROM river_job WHERE state = 'available' AND queue = $4::text AND ($5::text[] IS NULL OR kind = ANY($5::text[])) AND scheduled_at <= coalesce($1::timestamptz, now()) ORDER BY priority ASC, s
SELECT received_at,report FROM (SELECT received_at,report FROM server_metrics WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND server_id=$2 ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT $3) m ORDER BY received_at

UPDATE workspaces SET alert_scanned_at=$1 WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE alert_scanned_at<$1::timestamptz-interval $2 ORDER BY alert_scanned_at,id LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING id

WITH job_input AS ( SELECT unnest($1::bigint[]) AS id, unnest($2::boolean[]) AS attempt_do_update, unnest($3::int[]) AS attempt, unnest($4::boolean[]) AS errors_do_update, unnest($5::jsonb[]) AS errors, unnest($6::boolean[]) AS finalized_at_do_update, unnest($7::timestamptz[]) AS finalized_at, unnest($8::boolean[]) AS metadata_do_merge, unnest($9::jsonb[]) AS metadata_updates, unnest($10::boolean[

WITH raw_job_data AS ( SELECT unnest($1::bigint[]) AS id, unnest($2::jsonb[]) AS args, unnest($3::timestamptz[]) AS created_at, unnest($4::text[]) AS kind, unnest($5::smallint[]) AS max_attempts, unnest($6::jsonb[]) AS metadata, unnest($7::smallint[]) AS priority, unnest($8::text[]) AS queue, unnest($9::timestamptz[]) AS scheduled_at, unnest($10::text[]) AS state, unnest($11::text[]) AS tags, unne
UPDATE operational_alerts SET state=$6,reason=$4,resolved_at=$5 WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND kind=$2 AND resource_id=$3 AND state=$7 RETURNING id
begin
commit

DELETE FROM server_metrics WHERE (server_id,received_at) IN (SELECT server_id,received_at FROM server_metrics WHERE received_at<=now()-interval $1 ORDER BY received_at LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

SELECT r.id,r.environment_id FROM managed_resources r JOIN deployment_units u ON u.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND u.id=r.unit_id JOIN environments e ON e.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND e.id=r.environment_id JOIN specification_revisions v ON v.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND v.id=e.applied_revision_id WHERE r.workspace_id=$1 AND u.server_id=$2 AND EXISTS(SELECT $3 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.spec
SELECT kind,resource_id,environment_id FROM operational_alerts WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND server_id=$2 AND state=$3 AND kind IN ($4 /*, ... */) AND NOT(resource_id=ANY($5::uuid[]))
SELECT id,last_seen,revoked OR awaiting_transfer FROM servers WHERE workspace_id=$1 ORDER BY id LIMIT $2

WITH jobs_to_schedule AS ( SELECT id, unique_key, unique_states, priority, scheduled_at FROM river_job WHERE state IN ('retryable', 'scheduled') AND priority >= 0 AND queue IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_at <= coalesce($1::timestamptz, now()) ORDER BY priority, scheduled_at, id LIMIT $2::bigint FOR UPDATE ), jobs_with_rownum AS ( SELECT id, unique_key, unique_states, priority, scheduled_at, CASE WHEN u

UPDATE river_leader SET expires_at = coalesce($1::timestamptz, now()) + make_interval(secs => $2) WHERE elected_at = $3::timestamptz AND expires_at >= coalesce($1::timestamptz, now()) AND leader_id = $4 RETURNING elected_at, expires_at, leader_id, name
SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id,p.server_id,p.environment_id,p.status,p.configuration,s.revoked OR s.awaiting_transfer FROM backup_policies p JOIN servers s ON s.id=p.server_id WHERE p.workspace_id=$1 ORDER BY p.id LIMIT $2
SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_networks ORDER BY checked_at,workspace_id LIMIT 1000

DELETE FROM operational_alerts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM operational_alerts WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND state<>$3 AND (COALESCE(resolved_at,opened_at)<$2::timestamptz-interval $4 OR id IN (SELECT id FROM operational_alerts WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND state<>$5 ORDER BY opened_at DESC,id DESC OFFSET $6)) LIMIT $7)

SELECT o.id,o.command,o.environment_id,o.server_id FROM execution_operations o JOIN servers s ON s.id=o.server_id WHERE o.workspace_id=$1 AND NOT o.alert_observed AND o.state IN ($2 /*, ... */) ORDER BY o.created_at,o.id LIMIT $3 FOR KEY SHARE OF s

WITH topic_to_notify AS ( SELECT concat(coalesce($1::text, current_schema()), '.', $2::text) AS topic, unnest($3::text[]) AS payload ) SELECT pg_notify( topic_to_notify.topic, topic_to_notify.payload ) FROM topic_to_notify

DELETE FROM river_job WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM river_job WHERE ( (state = $10 AND $1 AND finalized_at < $2::timestamptz) OR (state = $11 AND $3 AND finalized_at < $4::timestamptz) OR (state = $12 AND $5 AND finalized_at < $6::timestamptz) ) AND ( $7::text[] IS NULL OR NOT (queue = any($7)) ) AND ( $8::text[] IS NULL OR queue = any($8) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT $9::bigint )

UPDATE alert_deliveries SET state='leased',attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=$1::timestamptz+interval '30 seconds' WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM alert_deliveries WHERE state IN ('pending','leased') AND next_attempt_at<=$1 AND created_at>=$1::timestamptz-interval '24 hours' AND attempts<5 ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING id,workspace_id,alert_id,recipient_id,channe

SELECT id, args, attempt, attempted_at, attempted_by, created_at, errors, finalized_at, kind, max_attempts, metadata, priority, queue, state, scheduled_at, tags, unique_key, unique_states FROM river_job WHERE state = $4 AND id > $1::bigint AND attempted_at < $2::timestamptz ORDER BY id LIMIT $3

UPDATE alert_deliveries SET state='failed' WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM alert_deliveries WHERE state IN ('pending','leased') AND next_attempt_at<=$1 AND (created_at<$1::timestamptz-interval '24 hours' OR attempts>=5) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

SELECT w.id FROM workspaces w WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM troubleshooting_sessions t WHERE t.workspace_id = w.id AND t.state <> 'closed' AND (t.deadline_at <= now() - interval '1 minute' OR (t.state = 'offered' AND t.ticket_expires_at <= now()))) ORDER BY w.id FOR UPDATE OF w
SELECT id FROM preview_policies WHERE enabled AND next_discovery_at<=now() ORDER BY next_discovery_at,id LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT id FROM preview_requests WHERE state<>'deleted' AND next_check_at<=now() ORDER BY next_check_at,id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

INSERT INTO river_queue ( created_at, metadata, name, paused_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( coalesce($1::timestamptz, now()), coalesce($2::jsonb, $6::jsonb), $3::text, coalesce($4::timestamptz, $7), coalesce($5::timestamptz, $1::timestamptz, now()) ) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING name, created_at, metadata, paused_at, updated_at

SELECT workspace_id,server_id,id FROM backup_policies WHERE configuration->>$2=$3 AND configuration->>$4=$5 AND status->>$6=$7 AND status->>$8=configuration->>$9 AND status->>$10>$11 AND status->>$12<= $1::text ORDER BY coordinated_checked_at,id LIMIT $13

UPDATE troubleshooting_sessions SET state = 'closed',closed_at = now(),close_reason = 'expired',ticket_hash = NULL,browser_session_hash = NULL WHERE workspace_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) AND state <> 'closed' AND (deadline_at <= now() - interval '1 minute' OR (state = 'offered' AND ticket_expires_at <= now())) RETURNING workspace_id,id,actor_id

UPDATE cross_host_operations h SET receipts=( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(receipt.key, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(receipt.value->$1->$2)=$3 THEN jsonb_set(receipt.value,$4,COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(resource.value)=$5 THEN resource.value-$6 ELSE resource.value END ORDER BY resource.position) FROM jsonb_array_elements(receipt.value->$7->$8) WITH ORDINALITY resource(value,position) )

UPDATE execution_operations SET steps=$1,note=$2 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM execution_operations WHERE created_at<$3 AND state IN ($4 /*, ... */) AND (steps<>$5::jsonb OR note<>$6) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT $7 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

UPDATE pipeline_runs SET result=result-$1 WHERE id IN (SELECT p.id FROM pipeline_runs p JOIN execution_operations o ON o.id=p.id WHERE p.created_at<$2 AND o.state IN ($3 /*, ... */) AND p.result ? $4 ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT $5 FOR UPDATE OF p SKIP LOCKED)
DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expiry < current_timestamp
DELETE FROM github_app_authorizations WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM github_app_authorizations WHERE expires_at<now() ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
DELETE FROM hosted_billing_events WHERE received_at<now()-interval $1
DELETE FROM hosted_invitations WHERE expires_at<now()-interval $1
DELETE FROM password_resets WHERE expires_at<now()
DELETE FROM email_verifications WHERE expires_at<now()
